name: tcm-classics
description: Retrieves and explains the five TCM classics from Ni Haixia's lecture corpus; study and reference only, never a prescription.

displayDescription.zh: 检索《黄帝内经》《伤寒论》《金匮要略》《神农本草经》及针灸经络条文，仅供学习参考，不开方不下医嘱。
displayDescription.en: Retrieves and explains the five TCM classics from Ni Haixia's lecture corpus; study and reference only, never a prescription.
